# TSLink

> TSLink gives each existing app on a computer or server (a web app, folder or file, model API, or TCP service) its own private address on the owner's Tailscale network, so the owner can open it from their own devices, with a private home portal, health checks, alerts and access history. Agents can operate it through a CLI with versioned JSON or an MCP server with scoped roles. The owner can also grant named people access to HTTP and file apps until a deadline, or open an HTTP app to the public internet for a limited time through an expiring browser guest link or Funnel. TSLink requires a Tailscale account and is an independent project, not made or endorsed by Tailscale. Releases start at v0.1.0: `brew install --cask anydoor7/tap/tslink` on macOS and Linux, a zip archive on Windows, .deb and .rpm packages on Linux, or a source build.

TSLink does not install or supervise backend apps, isolate workloads on the publishing computer, or replace application login and permissions. It does not enforce per-person access on raw TCP, recall downloaded data, or close already accepted streams when a people grant expires. It does not authorize tools belonging to other MCP servers. Browser guest links can be forwarded and do not verify a person's identity, and a combined multi-computer inventory is not shipped in this version. The Homebrew cask name must stay fully qualified because Homebrew refuses unqualified casks from untrusted third-party taps. Windows zips are not Authenticode-signed; verify them against the Sigstore-signed checksums.txt. Building from source requires Go 1.27.1+ and Git. Fresh nodes need human enrollment and may need device approval.

## Guides

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): Install with Homebrew, a release archive, or from source, and complete enrollment.
- [Sharing and audiences](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/sharing.md): Private, public, HTTP, files, and TCP boundaries.
- [People](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/people.md): Named grants, deadlines, invitations, and revocation.
- [Health and alerts](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/health-and-alerts.md): Backend checks and best-effort alerts.
- [App recipes](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/apps.md): Detect and share apps already running.
- [Agent quickstart](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/agent-quickstart.md): Configure, share, hand off enrollment, verify, and undo.
- [Agents and MCP](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/agents.md): Local tools and result contracts.
- [Remote MCP](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/remote-mcp.md): Opt-in tailnet control and its authority.
- [JSON automation](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/json-automation.md): Versioned results and stable errors.
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/cli-reference.md): Commands and flags; check the installed binary's manifest.
- [Platforms](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/platforms.md): OS requirements and background service behavior.
- [Security](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Trust boundaries and reporting.
- [Choose a sharing tool](https://github.com/anydoor7/tslink/blob/main/docs/comparison.md): Dated, primary-source alternatives and trade-offs.
